name: Side plank
notes: Bodyweight lateral core hold. Record each side separately if needed.

guide.setup: Lie on one side with the elbow under the shoulder and legs stacked or staggered.
guide.execution: Lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from head to feet, then hold while breathing steadily.
guide.cues: Push the floor away. Keep hips high. Stack the shoulders.
guide.mistakes: Letting hips sag; rotating toward the floor; shrugging into the support shoulder; holding the breath.
